data.narrative:
Voya Energy is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Richard Wang, Matt Horton, and Steven Kaye. The target has raised $13M to date. The Climate & Energy sector comprises 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (Lenz Energy, ticker LNZA), including later-stage companies such as Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

The valuation analysis employs stage-progression methodology, which is applicable given the company's Seed stage and prior capital raise. Using the $13M total raised as a base proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for progression from Seed to Series A, this method implies a valuation of $32M. A peer-median approach was not feasible; while 9 same-sector peers exist, insufficient datapoints met the filtering criteria (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables—minimum 3 required). Reliance on all-sector medians would introduce material bias.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $28M (low) to $37M (high), with a median of $32M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression result. Primary uncertainties include the limited methodological foundation (single applicable method) and the absence of tight-peer benchmarking. Validation would benefit from access to recent Series A terms in the frontier-energy subsector and further clarity on unit economics and technology risk.
